horoscopes.horoscope: A tough, action-packed day ahead! There may be difference of opinions with friends over trivial matters, but you will thrive on it. But all pending work will be completed, much to your relief. It’s a promising and optimistic day, says Ganesha!. Discussing intellectual matters with your lover will help you enjoy a great evening, predicts Ganesha. You may try to woo your partner by wearing a red dress or an aromatic perfume. You might intensify your love by playing some exciting love games, feels Ganesha. Ganesha predicts a good day for you today. Your logic will help you handle things in a better manner today. Your mind will be very sharp today. Besides, you will be full of energy which help you all through the day. You are most likely to retain your focus on making financial plans, rather than action, which is good for you because you will hardly have time to think about spending money on anything. Today, your boss will vouch for your excellent performance if you work on any software which demands the use of eclectic information. With logical discussions on the card, your brain will be crammed with new ideas and knowledge. Your intelligence will help in executing new complex projects.

Today, you may have something at the back of your mind that will grip you with its complexity, says Ganesha. Speak freely as your words are capable of making a great impact on others. You may not be willing to confront unpleasant situations today. Don’t worry, the stars seem in your favour, predicts Ganesha. A romantic evening awaits you says Ganesha, with your lover. Dining out with your loved one and enjoying a sumptuous meal at an exotic restaurant are on your cards. It would be a good idea if you gift a romantic novel to your better half. The day will be pretty productive for you. You will try increasing your efficiency. Health wise too you won’t face any problem today. However, you should avoid too much verbal communication with others as it could make you feel tired. You may feel confused about your financial future and may start speculating over various aspects related to your income. However, the day will also require other types of action on your part. Your gift of the gab will come handy today in all verbal communications related to work, whether it’s a meeting or any informal discussion. The practical view will be helpful in solving complex problems whereas emotional opinions will catch the attention of your superior to explore new opportunities.

Today, you would love to spend as much time alone as possible with your sweetheart, says Ganesha. A casual conversation between the two of you may culminate into a sensuous consummation. In the evening, you will keep people charmed with your wit and wisdom, feels Ganesha. Since you’re all charged up, your hormones too will play a trick on you when you meet your sweetheart. You will come up with some excellent jokes and your sweetheart won’t complain. He or she will melt in your words. A funny night is on the cards, foresees Ganesha. Brimming with zest and confidence, divert your energy in the right direction to make the most of this wonderful day. Also beware of jealous people and antagonists in your workplace, else they may pose hurdles in your path to progress. You are most likely to remain unsure about your financial matters. You wouldn’t be able to decide on what to do in order to earn more. You won’t also be able to judge ways and means of saving money. Blame it on the Red Bull you gulped down on your way to the office, but today, you’re fired up with a generous dose of energy. Hence, you’ll be fantastic while working on improvement and earn many compliments. You will inspire your team to achieve tough projects, feels Ganesha.

If you are a stockbroker, you may feel that things are not going too well for you. Today, you may regret being a stockbroker. Manufacturers must delay the launch of a new product. However, after a waiting game, you may go on to launch the product with a fanfare. Ganesha wishes you a good luck. The torrential downpour of love in your personal life will soothe your frayed nerves and create a perfect ambiance for a romantic evening. Playing hide and seek with your loved one or cuddling with him or her will make your love life really pleasurable. Your memory power will soar today. Hence Ganesha says that this is the best time for students to memorise difficult topics and hard subjects. However, you may not think logically, and your judgement about some individuals may be wrong. You are likely to be a spendthrift today and will blow your hard-earned money rather recklessly, which is bound to burn a big hole in your pockets. Your earnings, though, will not grow commensurately. You may spend a lot of time and energy on tasks that are not on your priority list. Ganesha advises you to rein in your temper. Be careful while talking with the employees. After all, your feelings aren’t the only thing important in this world.

The travel bug inside you is itching to be let loose, but things are not so simple when it comes to finding new destinations, says Ganesha. With you, holidaying goes hand in hand with delays. So, although you might be excited at the prospect of going to new places, this excitement will be somewhat curtailed thanks to postponements of travel plans. Well, such is life, so don’t go about taking it to heart and getting all upset. You may also broaden your mental horizons through debates and discussions. A private discussion will turn on your mood. You will be happy to spoonfeed your spouse. Your sweetheart will be more expressive than you. You will be feeling safe in the arms of your sweetheart. Look forward to a great day in your workplace. With your energy levels soaring and mood taking an upward swing, you shall easily manage challenging tasks. Both seniors and juniors in office will support and encourage you to complete your work. Today you are going to be happy with your financial status. You will have good scope of earning money, foresees Ganesha. Those who owe you money will likely pay up today. Some technical glitches at the workplace will stick out like stubborn sore thumbs, refusing to fall in line. Your inability to solve complex issues may frustrate you no end, but you won’t miss a chance to flaunt your skills and earn some brownie points, foresees Ganesha.

Motivation will remain high today, says Ganesha. Your talents and skills make you stand out as a superb artist. Words will glow if you let your creativity flow, and should you decide to dance or sing, you’ll set the stage on fire today. Cultivate hobbies in performing arts and literature, advises Ganesha. It’s not a good time to question your lover’s honesty, reminds Ganesha. Avoid being unfair to your lover by depriving him or her of your TLC- tender loving care. Be attentive to him/her and you will be rewarded handsomely, feels Ganesha. Overflowing with energy and exuberance, this day is perfect to utilise your time for preparing plans to move ahead on the path to progress. Also devote time for everyone in your family. Resolve domestic issues, especially related to spouse and kids. A good and lucrative job offer may also enthuse you today, feels Ganesha. This is ideal time to switch job to a better paying job or even if you wish to change your vocation, this is a favourable day. Today, all your actions mean ‘business’. Wasting time on futile matters will not be your cup of tea because you really want to advance professionally. You may ignore some people who might crack some funny jokes around you. Your focused and practical energy will help you accomplish the important projects.

Being in charge was never easy, but it’s not for nothing that leaders are made of sterner stuff. As a person in charge, you are expected to give directions in a manner that gets the best efforts out of your juniors. Move away from traditional dictatorial style, and build a consensus that enables you to pull off the spectacular, says Ganesha. Actually, you’re twice blessed today, because even the time you spend with your lover is going to be a memorable one! What would be better than a green cocktail and strawberry ice cream? You will have a wonderful night, says Ganesha. Luck is going to be in your favor from dawn to dusk on this opportune day. Although you are benevolent and considerate, you may not prefer to lend your helping hand to anyone in your professional or social circle today. Today your efforts are unlikely to bear any fruits on the financial front, so Ganesha advises you to rely on some of your close confidants to boost your finances, and hope that your luck is good. If you’ve been disgruntled with your boss about your salary, today is the good day to walk into the lion’s den and demand a fair share. Just do it politely, advises Ganesha, and you will succeed because luck is on your side, says Ganesha.

You shall follow all things to the dot today. Your approach will be methodical and robotic. It is likely that you shall symbolise the saying, ‘Actions speak louder than words’. Your powers of persuasion will help you amass the confidences of many, predicts Ganesha. You might get attracted to the enticing looks of your loved one. You might be interested in some cupid games. But be cautious. You might turn selfish. You tend to stimulate your loved one until you are satisfied. Intimate affairs are on the cards, foresees Ganesha. In the morning, you may feel very low and lethargic. Yet, try to shun all the negative thoughts, else it may have a detrimental effect on your health. Look at the brighter side of everything and exercise daily to stay fit. Your financial standing is likely to cause you a lot of worries today, feels Ganesha. You may feel that your earning are not commensurate with your your potential. You could have done better. Current astral configuration makes it impossible for you to complete a project. Shrug off those frustrations. Think what Thomas Jefferson had said once, “Delay is preferable to error”. Doing meditation and yoga will help you keep cool and concentrated, foresees Ganesha.

Cupid is hunting and you are the game today. Cupid’s arrows will have you adrift on the ocean of love and turbulent emotions. Your rescue is imminent, when a member of the opposite sex answers your SOS calls. But use your discretion as to which boat you hitch a ride back home, says Ganesha. You might go to pamper your loved one so much that he or she puts on airs. Ganesha reminds you that anything in excess is bad. Giving daily commitment to your partner’s needs will give you a harmonious love life, says Ganesha. You may have to run from pillar to post on this very hectic day. Hence, make sure you start the day with a suitable workout and have a healthy breakfast. Don’t bother about what some jealous persons think about you. Generosity will be your second name today, and you shall be eager to blow your money on your close friends and family members. However, when it comes to spending on yourself, you shall not be too keen. Today, you might be flooded with pending works and feel frustrated, foresees Ganesha. Ganesha blesses you with the right spirit to achieve your targets. Maintain this energy level the next day if you want to continue performing well. Taking the pain in the first half would give you pleasure later.

The work load may take away all your vigour, leaving you lethargic and dull, but you will come out of the sluggish phase before it can do any harm to your reputation, says Ganesha. Being observant and attentive while in meetings will help you in the long run, and in more ways than you can imagine. As you may have already guessed, it won’t be a very productive day, it but won’t be a very bad one either. After a hectic work schedule, you may have a little time for your partner, but the few hours you are together will be joyous. Thinking out-of the box things will spark your married life. Singles will be looking for long-term commitment, feels Ganesha. No doubt, you work arduously and honestly. But, continuously working hard may adversely affect your health. To remain fit and fine for a long time, you need to exercise regularly, follow a healthy diet and also adopt a comfortable lifestyle. Today is not too favorable for you in financial matters, foresees Ganesha. Especially, if someone owes you money, you shall find it extremely difficult to make them pay up their debts to you. You will be more engrossed in finishing tasks whose deadlines are due than in rectifying past errors made by someone else. Like a true leader, you will motivate your team members to give their best shot. You will be more concerned about team’ s success rather than that of individual.

You get a pat on the back due to your brilliant academic standing. People will admire your business acumen and may imitate your choices. But this doesn’t mean you become haughty and unapproachable. Carry on the good work with a humble attitude, says Ganesha. As evening approaches, watching the latest flick with your love mate will be the only thing in your mind. You may even get a special gift from your loved one. A lovely cocktail will make the evening special, feels Ganesha. Look forward to taste success on all fronts on this wonderful day. Overflowing with zest and vigour, this is the right time to apply your mind for resolving dicey issues in office and at home. Relax in the evening. Today is a favourable day to invest your money in the stock markets, feels Ganesha. Your intuition will be strong regarding financial matters, but too much thinking about it can muddle up your mind. Honing your skills is an investment you should make as today’s celestial energies bless you with the right frame of mind. If you are confused about a project, seek help from your boss, who will be more than eager to guide you.

Anticipation is all the fun. Sadly, this only alludes to your months-in-preparation travel plans that are most likely to be delayed today on one count or the other. Though, if this is any consolation, your trip, when it finally occurs, will bring you as much pleasure and satisfaction that you expected out of it, if not more, says Ganesha. Fill your lover’s heart with passion and head with imagination. Romantic life will sizzle today and you and your partner may enjoy a pleasant time together. You may spend a wonderful time with your loved one watching a sweet rom-com, suggests Ganesha. You are likely to become very emotional today. Your mind will be inclined to think logically, but you shall act as directed by your soft heart. Consequently, your energy may get scattered and you might get confused while taking decisions. You have an intuitive way of going about your financial matters and today your sixth sense will be at its peak. However, you may find it difficult to decide whether to buy a new house or a new vehicle. Your imaginative mood may not go well with the serious people at the workplace. You may remain confused about certain aspects of your professional life today, says Ganesha. The best thing for you to do is to take stock of the situation by weighing the pros and cons before taking any decision.
